DescriptionGit - Merge branches without conflicts between master and MyBranch. Verifies EPBDS-8488: the merge commit is authored by the WebStudio user's display name, not a .gitconfig identity, and the first save on MyBranch after a module is deleted and another uploaded succeeds (regression guard for EPBDS-16361). Both branches change MySpr1 of the same sheet: Sync combines the sheet without a conflict, the steps both branches add at its end are all kept, those of the receiving branch first, and the Save dialog, the Sync dialog and the Merge Summary show the files and the sheet the merge combines (EPBDS-16883, EPBDS-16884, EPBDS-16962, EPBDS-16896), and the Sync dialog expects the merge to go without a conflict (EPBDS-17092).

MethodtestDeleteProjectWithUnsavedRulesEditSucceeds
Test caseEPBDS-16229, EPBDS-16432, EPBDS-16232
Known issue—
DescriptionDeleting a project must succeed even when the name in its descriptor was changed and the project was not saved: a project is named by its descriptor, so writing another name into rules.xml renames the working copy while the repository still holds the old one. Before the delete, the Revisions tab of the renamed project must list its history instead of answering Error 404 (EPBDS-16432). Copying such a project under a new name must succeed and give a project named as entered (EPBDS-16232).

Known issue—
DescriptionA project whose module declares a method filter of its own reloads once and settles: the loading overlay must reach a quiet window and the table must stay. Guards the reload loop of EPBDS-16275, which the JSF shell fell into after its ViewState was evicted; the filter is written into the descriptor, which is where a module's own filter is declared and where the card reads it from; the card then lifts it to the project, which is the migration this scenario reloads after.

MethodtestSingleModeAutoAuthentication
Test caseEPBDS-17081, EPBDS-17103, EPBDS-17102
Known issue—
DescriptionSingle-user mode, started with the settings a tool running OpenL Studio on a developer's machine passes: a file design repository set through the environment, no project creation or deletion, ignored folders. Opening the app auto-authenticates with no login form, and the single user has admin access (Administration menu visible). A project in a nested folder is listed, one in an ignored folder is not, and none can be created, copied or deleted. The project is edited in place: nothing to open, close or save, no revisions, an edit lands in the file, a change of the file on disk is told with Refresh, an edit over it is refused, and Refresh shows the file (EPBDS-16987). The local history keeps the version from disk and restores it, and a workbook and rules.xml changed on disk are told with Refresh.

Known issue—
DescriptionACL: project-level role assignment (Manager/Viewer on specific projects) and permission verification without external auth system. The audit log records the refused and the accepted sign-ins, the projects created and the roles granted and changed, finds the events of one project and exports them (EPBDS-14601). The Username field of the Add access dialog on the Management tab of a project hints at a username, not at an email address (EPBDS-16598). When the admin removes the project role of a user who has the project open, the project disappears from the user's list (EPBDS-14474)
